title: My Brother Forged The Title To Our Carousel, Sold It For $1.3M. So I Watched Him Become The Clown.
description: At 57, I emptied my $112K retirement to restore a century-old carousel with my brother, who promised me 40% of earnings. He forged the sole-ownership title, sold the ride to a theme park for $1.3 million, and offered me a $4,000 finder's fee. I found our late mother's hidden notarized memo, proved fraud in court, and now own the carousel, leasing it as 'Painted Ponies & Perjury' while he dresses as a ticket-taker clown under a 'Merry-Go-Round of Justice' banner. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #CarouselJustice
thumb_text: MOM'S HIDDEN MEMO MADE HIM THE CLOWN
pinned_comment: If your brother forged the title to your shared $112K carousel and tried to buy your silence with a $4,000 check, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: OUR LATE MOTHER HID THE NOTARIZED MEMO IN HER RECIPE BOX
